content:
Jimmy Fallon traces the roots of Trump's latest hair mystery after the president's blonde locks noticeably darkened last week.

Fallon joked on Tuesday's Tonight Show: "This is what happens when you let the guy from the Reflecting Pool dye your hair."

The comedian then aired a mock commercial for a fictional hair dye called "Just For Men: Touch Of Cray."

The ad's voiceover says: "Just use Touch of Cray for one week and you'll grow new hair and start renaming states, flirting with assistants, kidnapping world leaders, invading Canada, putting your face on every coin, hosting a boxing match in the front yard, and posting an AI video of you dabbing with Abraham Lincoln."

Fallon said: "It all makes sense now."
